hypotheses.reasoning: The first anomaly shows up at 05:32:16 in catalog-svc: calls to the external translation API (api.translate.example) start getting slow, going 3.9s, then 7.8s, then 13.7s, and from 05:33:38 they fail at the 30s upstream timeout. The search-api calls to catalog-svc /products/batch with the same trace ids also time out at 30s (t-1865, t-1881, t-1894). Because these slow calls hold connections, the search-api pool to catalog-svc fills up (50/50, queue growing from 39 to 92) and pool checkouts start timing out. search-api then returns 503s, and web-bff reports them as GET /search 5xx. Before 05:32 everything is healthy, and there are no deploy logs. The disk, TLS-cert, rate-limiter and index-worker GC warnings don't match the timing or the failing call path.

The slow dependency is a third-party translation provider, so this could be read as an outage on the provider's side. But the logs show it getting slower and then timing out, not refusing connections or returning 5xx, which fits a dependency timeout better.

verdict.recommendedAction: Have catalog-svc stop waiting on the translation API: set a short timeout on those calls (for example 2s), add a circuit breaker, and return untranslated or cached text when it fails. Also give search-api a lower timeout for catalog-svc calls and use bulkheads so slow calls can't take every connection in the pool. Contact the translation provider about the latency.
